top20pct_sv_dims.interpretation: Top-20% SVD dims carry 59.5% of cosine mass but only 20.8% of discriminative signal — a 2.86× over-representation of object content in the score.

access_ratio.interpretation: Access ratio 8.601 (95% CI [8.431, 8.762]): the most discriminative 5% of dimensions receive 8.60× their proportional cosine weight (vs 1.0 for uniform, 1.18× for SV²-proportional null). Masking is reliable (p=1.0000 that ratio ≥ 1.0).

structural_argument: The 1.7% (ρ²) from the original Table 1 is a property of the MLP proxy, not of the geometric effect. The direct measurement shows: top-20% SVD dims carry 59.5% of cosine similarity mass but only 20.8% of per-dimension discriminability. This 2.86× amplification of object-level cosine mass over compositional-discriminative mass is the structural mechanism. The Spearman ρ² is the wrong statistic to report — it measures correlation between a scale-confounded proxy and rank, not the actual geometric suppression of compositional signal in the similarity score.
